_readme: BGM 风格目录: 脚本只写 bgm_style 的 id，工具按这里的 tags 生成音乐提示词。新增风格往这里加一项即可，不用改代码。2026-10-25 作者试听裁决：爵士/国风/摇滚的 AI 生成效果不好听，已移除，不要再加回来。

cinematic-piano.label: 电影钢琴弦乐
cinematic-piano.tags: cinematic piano and strings, emotional, gentle build to a moving climax

electronic-pulse.label: 电子脉冲
electronic-pulse.tags: modern electronic, pulsing synths, driving beat, futuristic

epic-soaring.label: 激昂史诗
epic-soaring.note: 巅峰、逆袭、热血题材，要的就是燃
epic-soaring.tags: epic orchestral, soaring strings, heroic brass, thunderous cinematic drums, triumphant

hisaishi-style.label: 久石让风
hisaishi-style.note: 成长、回忆、天空感，治愈而昂扬
hisaishi-style.tags: Joe Hisaishi style orchestral, lyrical piano arpeggios, warm strings and woodwinds, nostalgic wonder

trails-battle.label: 轨迹燃曲
trails-battle.note: 轨迹系列式 JRPG 战斗曲：小提琴主奏＋摇滚乐队，热血推进
trails-battle.tags: Falcom Trails style JRPG battle theme, soaring violin lead, electric guitar riffs, energetic piano runs, driving rock drums, heroic and burning

warm-folk.label: 温暖民谣
warm-folk.note: 治愈向、女性人物、平凡英雄
warm-folk.tags: warm acoustic folk, fingerstyle guitar and soft piano, healing and hopeful

xenoblade-epic.label: 异刃史诗
xenoblade-epic.note: 异度之刃式管弦摇滚＋无词合唱，压倒性高潮（Counterattack 风）
xenoblade-epic.tags: Xenoblade style orchestral rock, dramatic sweeping strings, powerful brass, wordless choir, electric guitar, overwhelming cinematic climax
